bullets.content: [general] After solve 1 ALWAYS view(kind=error) and list top-5 hotspots with local h vs requested size. Refine next at the largest-share hotspot whose local h >1.3x the size you asked for (or exceeds ~0.8x your refinement size).

[general] One factor per solve: S1 frame, S2 one new target, S3 the other target, S4 fine reference or best combination. Write the single change before each mesh() call; two simultaneous changes (body size + rim box) taught nothing.

[general] Choose submitted solve by score=(g/2)^2/c (c=DOFs/automesher DOFs), not error alone; a 1.56x gain at 3x DOFs lost. If energies differ <1% or compare <5%, submit the cheaper mesh (a15 submitted the costlier). Spend solves on structural changes.

[general] Use all 4 solves: s1 variant, s2 unmodified control (compare baseline), s3 sub-split of the change (attribution), s4 best combination or DOF-saving variant. Call compare(s2,s1), read regions; trust differences only above 5-7%.
[general] After solve 1 view(kind=error, view=y) and read hotspot h vs requested; after solve 2 compare(2,1) to see where the field moved. Skipping both missed boxes delivering 1.7x their size.
[general] Compare node count with every playbook recipe (a3/a15 5638, a8 5997, a13 6205). A recipe copied verbatim ties a peer: change a size by >=10% or the target set.
[general] A compare stress_diff of ~7% between meshes ~2% apart in DOFs means local non-convergence, not noise. Read regions[0].at and nearest_group and put the next refinement there.
[general] Never make solve 2 coarser than solve 1 with simultaneous changes (h 0.011->0.013 dropped energy 1.5%). To cut DOFs, loosen only the region with least error share.
[general] Identify the binding term first: field error (11.3%) bound while probe error (6.2%) did not. Refine where error ENERGY is, not around the probes.
[general] For an order experiment, match DOFs by rescaling h and all sizes by (target_nodes/nodes)^(1/3), then compare against an order-2 control of known score.
[general] Order-1 sizing (estimate): at equal DOFs P1 needs ~8-10x vertices of P2, size ~0.45-0.5x. P1 error falls only ~N^-1/3. Check via compare against the P2 control.

[general] A box with radius 0.001 does not deliver its size: asked 0.0032, got 0.00407. Use radius >=0.002 and size <=0.8x target local h. a15's 0.0022 box delivered 0.003 (1.36x) at 43% share: tighten to 0.0018.
[general] Nested boxes must be <=0.6x the box they sit in: 0.0034 inside 0.0045 (0.76x) and 0.003 where h 0.0043 (0.7x) added DOFs with little effect. Use <=0.0027 inside 0.0045.
[general] Do not tune radii by small amounts: nodes stayed ~4000-4100 and field moved only 7-8%. Make larger structural changes.
[general] Avoid near-uniform fine h (h 0.006: 16827 DOFs, ~25% score cost). Raise global h and spend saved elements at hotspots.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Reference-free estimate understated true error ~1.5x (9.8% vs 14.3%); estimate above ~8% is unsafe. Submit where top-5 hotspots have local h <=0.004 (order 2) and diffs to finest are smallest.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Highlight a3 (rank 1): split body boxes (lower z 0-0.021 at 0.0046, upper z 0.019-0.0575 at 0.0058), four quadrant boxes 0.0032, rim boxes 0.003, f2 + edge 40 at 0.0025. Field 17.43% at 21.2k DOFs. Use as frame.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Assigned variant: a3 solve-4 recipe (7073 nodes, 0.033576 J) with ONLY rim boxes moved from z 0.025-0.035 to 0.020-0.039. Expect 7300-7600 nodes; pays if energy >= ~0.03368 J.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Shaft radius ~8 mm, centred z~0.0306, root ring z ~0.022-0.039. Rim boxes z 0.025-0.035 cut it off: a3 junction cells held 3.1-3.6% at h 0.0046-0.005, and (-0.0174,0.0043,0.0357) 2.7% at h 0.0056.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Never omit {edge:40, 0.0025, r0.004} beside f2 0.0025 r0.005: without it a15's clamp-ring cells at z 0.0561 held 17.0% (21-22% VM at h 0.0043) vs a3's 15.4%. Supersedes the older 'edge 40 redundant' note.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Junction zone 0.0045->0.0040 gave +0.43% energy for +4.2% DOFs, field 17.4%; junction cells fell to 2.4-3.0%. Self view: 21.5k DOFs for +0.4% energy was waste (cost 0.282). Judge by score; avoid going finer.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Do not end a box on a hotspot band. Flank zmin 0.021 left saddle hotspots (|x| 0.014,|y| 0.009, z 0.021-0.022) at 8.5%, h 0.0041. Start flank/rim boxes at z 0.019-0.020.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Lower-wall cell near f20 z 0.005 read 6% high under 0.0056 lower zone with junction box from z 0.018. Keep lower-zone boxes ending at z>=0.021, other boxes starting z>=0.019-0.020.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp-ring hotspots sit ~2 mm below edge 40 (z~0.0555) at h ~0.004 despite 0.0025 requests. A clamp box only bites at <=0.0026. Self idea: points (0,±0.0147,0.0558),(±0.0147,0,0.0558) at 0.0028 r0.005 or top box 0.0042 instead of finer junction.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Hotspots on f20 near z 0.022 have 14-15% VM error at h 0.004; near z 0.055 21-22%. Top ones are worse: prioritise the clamp ring.
[abc_00000003_bc7] DOFs bind (21.5k vs 6k automesher). Try h 0.014 and lower body z<0.018 boxes 0.006, target <=15k DOFs at field ~18%.
[abc_00000003_bc7] f15 and f17 end caps at h 0.008 are coarse with low error: leave coarse.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Diversity needs a frame nobody else runs. The zoned body was used by both a10 and a15 in gen 6, so no bonus. Check peers' likely frames before claiming uniqueness.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Field ranking by energy held: 0.033449->0.033593 J gave field 17.4%. e²N 650 vs a0 626. Below target prefer the cheaper of two candidates within 0.1% energy.
[general] Right after solve 1 view(kind=error) and list each hotspot >=2% with local h vs requested size. a15 skipped it twice and missed a 17% clamp-ring block at h 0.0043 under a 0.0025 request.
[abc_00000003_bc7] Older explorer: h 0.012, body box 0.0062 r0.008; 4 rim points 0.0025 r0.006; 4 saddle points 0.003; 2 clamp points (0,±0.0147,0.0558) 0.003 r0.008. Est 16-18k DOFs, field <=18%.

[abc_00000003_bc7] Rim hotspots 0.5-1 mm off f16/f19 at (±0.019-0.0197,±0.007-0.008,z 0.029-0.031), 12% of error. Edge boxes left f16 h 0.0057. Use points size <=0.0022-0.0025, radius 0.006 centred on hotspots; check delivered h.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] Zone frame needs >=2 mm overlaps (0.018-0.021, 0.036-0.038). Keep lower zone <=0.0056: lower-wall cell near f20 z 0.005 is most contested (spread 6.9%); 0.0058-body runs read ~11% low.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] Rim boxes [±0.015..0.024,|y|<=0.01,z 0.025-0.035] at 0.003 delivered f16 0.0055, f19 0.0051, leaving saddle hotspots (x 0.013,|y| 0.010,z 0.026) at h 0.0055 with 6.1%. Flank boxes must start at |x| 0.012 and reach |y| 0.013.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] z 0.0255 band holds ~27% of error (8 cells 2.8-3.9% at h ~0.005) plus wall cells (±0.0058,±0.0129) 2.6-2.7% each. A full-width junction zone z 0.018-0.038 at <=0.0045 covers walls flank boxes miss.

[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] Highlight a13: flank boxes [0.012,-0.012,0.022,0.023,0.012,0.0345] and mirror 0.003 r0.004, body 0.0054, f2 0.003: 0.03333 J, 18.6k DOFs, field 18.7%, points 8.1%, best energy/DOF. Adapt its flanks inside the zone frame.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] Body box 0.0054 over whole body acts as near-uniform fine h (65% elements at 0.0048, error 20%). Try h 0.014 with body box 0.0065, spend savings at junction hotspots.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Calibration: energy 0.03307 J→field 20.2%, 0.03316-0.03323→18.9%, 0.03333→18.7%, 0.03336-0.03339→17.9%. Use to estimate e and e²·N before submitting.
[abc_00000003_bc7] [general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup: fixed f2, pressures 4e6 on f23 and 2.1e6 on f16, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, 3D. Consistent with statement; keep.
